fact_cards.statement_en: Modelled: in East Uusimaa wellbeing services county, an estimated 25.0 (5.3-55.6)% of lung cancer patients who got surgery, radiotherapy or drug therapy within 6 months started it within 42 days of referral (median, 95% interval). The width comes mainly from the unpublished referral-to-diagnosis time.
fact_cards.source: Tasan Pathway Twin (sim/), calibrated to Keuhkosyöpä Suomessa 2024 Taulukko 4.1/4.5; volumes Taulukko 11 (2026)
fact_cards.caveat: MODEL OUTPUT; referral->diagnosis is an ASSUMPTION (7-35 d median); county timing inherited from collaborative area.
